look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson twenty-one
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 5, lesson T21, Confirmation, False Signals and NO_TRADE; one past line forks into three futures; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Same past, three futures
scenes.desc: Fictional BTC/USDT 5-minute chart: two rejections at the 60,000-60,050 zone, price back at 59,970; three futures branch: 60,350, 59,960, 59,650.

scenes.name: What confirmation is
scenes.desc: Confirmation defined; a close beyond the zone and a hold; dark-clouds analogy with a likelihood meter that never reaches certain; can and cannot.

scenes.name: Weak or conflicting
scenes.desc: Weak vs conflicting evidence; a balance scale takes four weights (wick, trend, resistance, fading volume) and ends level: NO_TRADE.

scenes.name: A false breakout
scenes.desc: False signal defined; a candle forms, wicks to 60,090 and closes at 59,960; a 0.01 BTC buy at 60,060 shows -1.00 USDT before fees.

scenes.name: Momentum fade
scenes.desc: Momentum and fade defined; ball-uphill analogy; four green candles gain 80, 50, 25, 10 USDT on falling volume; a warning, not proof.

scenes.name: Hindsight bias
scenes.desc: The finished breakout looks obvious; a curtain hides the future to show what was known at decision time.

scenes.name: NO_TRADE is a decision
scenes.desc: NO_TRADE defined; cricket analogy (leaving a ball outside off stump); a written condition not met; NO_TRADE stamp, 0 fees and 0 new risk.

scenes.name: Judging by outcome
scenes.desc: Mistake: judging a decision by what happened next; process vs outcome grid; review reasons, not results.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: New candles revealed one at a time: a wick to 60,070, closes inside the zone, falling volume; BUY / SELL / WAIT with a 5-second countdown; answer C, WAIT, with why not A and B.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Confirmed signals still fail; later entries; stops can slip; leverage; fictional, NO_TRADE allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and a check question about waiting when price later rose.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T22, Position Sizing and Risk Budget.
